description: Defines classes and functions for RTP media packet handling and Bluetooth socket communication in the Thunder namespace, including MediaPacket, OutboundMediaPacketType, and ClientSocket.

classes.name: MediaPacket
classes.description: Represents an RTP media packet with methods for packing and unpacking audio data.

classes.name: OutboundMediaPacketType
classes.description: Template class for outbound RTP media packets with buffer management.

classes.name: ClientSocket
classes.description: Abstract class for Bluetooth RTP client socket handling socket state and MTU configuration.

methods.name: Pack
methods.description: Packages audio payload into RTP packet buffer.

methods.name: Unpack
methods.description: Unpacks RTP payload into audio data buffer.

methods.name: Ingest
methods.description: Ingests audio data for RTP packetization.

methods.name: Operational
methods.description: Virtual method to indicate socket operational status.
